architectureDecisions: D1 — Suite: 8 fixtures bug-sum, bug-clamp (bug-fix), feat-prefix, feat-count (feature), refactor-extract, refactor-rename (test-guided-refactor), multifile-split, multifile-config (multi-file). task.json = { id, category, prompt, visibleVerifications, hiddenVerifications }. Tree = repo/**, hidden/**, solution.patch, task.json. fixtures/manifest.json lists ids. EV1: base fails hidden; base+solution.patch passes hidden and visible; hidden/** absent from the agent worktree.

D2 — Arms, delivered names only: DIRECT_SINGLE = one runObservedInvocation; DIRECT_RETRY = up to K runObservedInvocation on the same worktree with resume and prompt "Continue until the task is complete." (no verification output); EXHARNESS_SUPERVISED = runSupervisedTask with createSupervisedObservation (invocationObserver, eventSinks, tracer), maxAttempts K, visibleVerifications only. observeInvocation does not exist. K=3, timeoutMs=600000, permissionProfile WORKSPACE_EDIT. Model explicit or TOOL_DEFAULT in producerProfile.hash. DIRECT_RETRY stops after two consecutive no-change exits. Tools = AGENT_TOOLS keys plus grok iff AGENT_TOOLS.grok exists.

D3 — One createExperimentRegistration per tool: experimentId agent-tools-value:<tool>; protocol {id:AGENT_TOOLS_VALUE_V1, version:1, hash} over {arms,K,timeouts,permissionProfile,model,R,seed,HIDDEN_ACCEPTANCE_RATE,D5,maxInvocationsTotal,maxUsd}; workloadManifest {ref:benchmarks/agent-tools/fixtures, digest:suite sha256}; producerProfile {id:tool, hash} including expectedToolVersion; resourceBudget hash over {K,timeoutMs,maxInvocationsTotal,maxUsd}; evaluatorIdentity hidden-command-verifier; unitIds. createBenchmarkUnit per (fixture×arm×repeat). Write <out>/registration.json before beginAttempt; refuse on registrationDigest or live toolVersion mismatch.

D4 — Experiment-owned adapter (BB-065 D5/D8; not assertSubstratePort): AttemptLedger.registerUnit; beginAttempt; materialize repo/**; createLocalGitWorkspace; execute arm with traces; checkpoint; independent eval on a detached checkout with hidden/** via createLocalCommandVerifier; normalizeOutcome (all hidden PASS→ACCEPTED, FAIL→REJECTED, unavailable/error→NOT_EVALUATED); normalizeAccounting from traces plus providerCostUsd when grok reports total_cost_usd; createEvidenceManifest roles RAW_RESULT, USAGE_OBSERVATION, RESET_IDENTITY, NORMALIZATION, TRAJECTORY; settleAttempt; fresh-process auditAttempt. Producer exit is not quality.

D5 — Per tool, pair (task,repeat). delta = 1[ACCEPTED](SUPERVISED)−1[ACCEPTED](X) for X in {DIRECT_RETRY,DIRECT_SINGLE}; 10000 seeded paired-bootstrap; 95% interval. SUPERIOR if lower>0, INFERIOR if upper<0, else INCONCLUSIVE. Also falseSuccessRate (direct exit 0 or SUPERVISED ACCEPTED while REJECTED), median durationMs, invocations, covered tokens. NOT_EVALUATED excluded from rates; count with NOT_INSTALLED, ADAPTER_NOT_DELIVERED, TOOL_UNAVAILABLE, USD_CAP_UNENFORCEABLE, MAX_INVOCATIONS.

D6 — EV3 calibration: FIX_FIRST, FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK, NEVER_FIX, CLAIM_SUCCESS_NO_EDIT on bug-sum+feat-prefix, R=2 (12 attempts), --tool codex --command packages/agent-tools/test/fixtures/fake-agent.mjs, env FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO and FAKE_AGENT_SOLUTION_PATCH (--fake-scenario only with --command). FIX_FIRST INCONCLUSIVE delta 0; FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK SUPERIOR vs both directs; NEVER_FIX INCONCLUSIVE rates 0; CLAIM_SUCCESS_NO_EDIT falseSuccessRate 1 direct / 0 SUPERVISED.

D7 — `exharness-agent eval --tool <id> [--command] [--model] [--out] [--tasks] [--repeats] [--max-invocations] [--max-usd] [--fake-scenario]`. Tests use os.tmpdir() --out. This-host grok: --tool grok --command /home/box/.grok/bin/grok --model grok-4.6 --tasks bug-sum,feat-prefix --repeats 1 --max-invocations 12 --max-usd 2. Overlay blanks TYPESAFE_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Missing AGENT_TOOLS.grok → NOT_EVALUATED ADAPTER_NOT_DELIVERED; missing executable → NOT_INSTALLED. Codex/Kiro/agy here: NOT_INSTALLED, never fabricated. Unreported USD → invocation cap only, USD_CAP_UNENFORCEABLE. Live INCONCLUSIVE is valid.

D8 — report.json/md: per-tool verdicts, intervals, rates, costs, coverage, registrationDigest, claim boundary (owned suite; grok does not replace Codex/Kiro/agy). evaluation.md describes method without Blackboard ids; state.md gains Evaluation.

D9 — Evidence: BB-099 evaluation probe; BB-065 D1/D2/D5/D8/D11/D12 PLANNED_CONTRACT (candidate index matches D2); delivered runSupervisedTask, runObservedInvocation, createSupervisedObservation, fake-agent.mjs. BB-097 probe is argv history, not this-host install. process-runner inherits process.env; do not edit it.

D10 — `import { createExperimentRegistration, createBenchmarkUnit, AttemptLedger, normalizeOutcome, createEvidenceManifest, normalizeAccounting, auditAttempt, CONTRACT_KINDS, OUTCOME_ENUMS } from "@exharness/benchmark"` (package root; no ../../benchmark/src/index.js). No OBJECTIVE_SUPERSESSION. BB-105 is PLANNED_CONTRACT, not a graph edge. Do not add grokTool.

negativeVerificationCases: A fixture whose base already passes hidden tests, or whose solution fails them, fails calibration.
hidden/** is never present in the agent worktree at any point of an attempt.
A registration digest or live toolVersion mismatch prevents the runner from starting or resuming.
Arms with different K, timeouts, model or permission profile for the same tool abort the run.
An attempt whose tool is unavailable is NOT_EVALUATED, excluded from rates and never counted as a failure or success.
A tool exit 0 or ExHarness ACCEPTED with failing hidden tests is counted as false success.
The same seed and inputs produce byte-identical report.json.
Exceeding maxInvocationsTotal stops execution and marks remaining attempts NOT_EVALUATED.
Any write to Core, Oracle, agentic-system, packages/benchmark, BB-097/BB-098 modules or docs/blackboard fails scope verification.
